observation.command: cd /workspace/deployments/example-opencode && for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do sleep 30; echo "=== iter $i ==="; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml ps --format '{{.Name}}: {{.Status}}' 2>&1; echo "--- fs-watcher tail:"; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml logs --tail 5 fs-watcher 2>&1 | tr '\r' '\n' | tail -5; echo "--- asr tail:"; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml logs --tail 8 asr-service 2>&1 | tr '\r' '\n' | grep -vE "DEBUG|httpcore|it/s" | tail -8; echo "--- watch dir:"; ls -la watch/; done
